entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: William Kemmler was the first person executed by electric chair (1890, New York). Edison promoted electrocution using Tesla's AC current to discredit his rival. The first execution was botched — Kemmler had to be shocked twice. Over 4,300 people were electrocuted in the US. The chair was called "Old Sparky."
